news.headline:
Inventurus Knowledge Solutions issued a corporate guarantee of USD 603.8M for subsidiary loans.

Refinanced a USD 70M loan; old USD 77M guarantee released, liability now USD 603.8M.

Source: ScoutQuest

IKS Ltd issued a corporate guarantee of $603.8M for lenders, including Citibank and Deutsche Bank.

IKS Inc refinanced a $70M term loan using facilities of $575M; prior $77M guarantee released.

Source: BSE

Aditya Birla Capital allotted ₹556.8 cr non-convertible debentures via private placement.

Source: ET NOW

Mankind Pharma receives US FDA approval for ANDA of Rivaroxaban tablets.

Source: ET NOW

Powergrid secures 80 billion yen green loan from JBIC for HVDC project.

Loan will aid renewable energy evacuation from Khavda park to demand centres.

Source: Business Standard
